qualifier: aromatic, sulfur and serine/threonine amino acids with pterin, B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Aromatic, sulfur and serine-family amino acid and cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover catabolism/synthesis of aromatic (Phe, Tyr, His), sulfur (Cys, transsulfuration, sulfide) and serine/glycine/threonine/proline amino acids plus BH4, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors, unlike confusables centred on glutamate/aspartate, alanine, glycine conjugation or generic organic acid metabolism.

qualifier: hexosamine, sialic acid and N-glycan precursor/processing
name: Hexosamine, sialic acid and N-glycan metabolism
rationale: Members share UDP-GlcNAc/hexosamine, mannose, sialic acid and dolichol-glucose metabolism feeding N-glycan processing (with GNE, GFPT1, ALG14, MOGS defects), distinct from confusables on fucose/O-glycans, GPI anchors, nucleotide-sugar transporters or GDP-mannose.

qualifier: Sanfilippo (MPS III) and Morquio (MPS IV) types
name: Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses (MPS III and IV)
rationale: All members are MPS III A-D or MPS IV A/B disease pathways, whereas confusables are dominated by Hurler, Hunter, Maroteaux-Lamy and Sly types or generic GAG degradation.

qualifier: FGFR1-3 fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic FGFR fusion and amplification signaling
rationale: Every member is signaling by FGFR1, FGFR2 or FGFR3 fusions or amplification mutants, while confusables concern ALK, KIT/PDGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 or LTK cancer variants.

qualifier: metaphase-anaphase transition and its inhibition
name: Control of meiotic metaphase-anaphase transition and chromosome separation
rationale: All three members concern the meiotic metaphase-to-anaphase transition and its negative regulation, unlike confusables on meiotic spindle, cohesion, chromosome alignment or mitotic checkpoint.

qualifier: DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and base cleavage, including glycosylase defects
name: DNA glycosylase damaged-base recognition and removal, including defects
rationale: Members are the glycosylase steps of base excision repair (recognition, purine/pyrimidine cleavage, APEX1 displacement) and defective OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1, NEIL1/3 variants, whereas confusables cover downstream AP-site resolution, gap filling and strand-break repair.

core: Endothelial VEGF and Tie2 receptor signaling
qualifier: negative control of sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial cadherin junctions
name: VEGFR/Tie2 signaling, sprouting inhibition and endothelial junction regulation
rationale: Members combine VEGF/VEGFR2/neuropilin and Tie2 signaling with negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial adherens junctions, unlike confusables on pro-angiogenic regulation, VEGF production or endothelial fate and differentiation.

qualifier: G12/13 and Sema4D inputs to Rho-ROCK/PAK, RND GTPases
name: Rho-ROCK signaling from G12/13 and Sema4D, with RND GTPases
rationale: Members share Rho activation via G12/13-coupled GPCRs and Sema4D-plexin-B, its ROCK/PAK effectors and the RND1-3 cycles, distinct from confusables on Sema3A, RAC/CDC42 GTPase cycles or ephrin-driven cytoskeletal signaling.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and SLC9 sodium/proton exchangers
name: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and SLC9 sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: Members cover cation-chloride cotransporters (Bartter, Gitelman, ACCPN defects), Na+/H+ exchangers (SLC9A6/A9 defects) and potassium transport, unlike confusables on SLC26/bicarbonate anion exchange or osmotic and renal sodium transport regulation.

qualifier: host and viral control of entry, genome replication and release
name: Host and virus control of viral entry, replication and release
rationale: Members are host- or virus-driven positive and negative regulation of viral entry, transport, replication, protein levels and release, lacking the interferon/ISG15 programmes and endocytic entry routes of the confusables.

qualifier: semaphorin-plexin and netrin repulsive signaling
name: Axon guidance by semaphorin-plexin and netrin repulsive signaling
rationale: Members share axon guidance and extension through Sema3A-plexin (CRMP, PAK, integrin) and netrin repulsion, distinct from confusables on ephrin, L1, DCC attraction, Sema4D or collateral sprouting.

qualifier: COPI retrograde, endosome-Golgi and Golgi-lysosome routes
name: COPI, endosome-Golgi and Golgi-lysosome vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members share Golgi vesicle budding and COPI traffic, endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport and Golgi-to-lysosome/endosome sorting, unlike confusables on COPII ER export, Golgi structural organization or plasma-membrane recycling.

qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK/NPAS2 and CRY:PER transcriptional feedback loop
name: Core circadian clock BMAL1:CLOCK and CRY:PER feedback loop
rationale: Members describe expression, phosphorylation and repression of BMAL1:CLOCK/NPAS2 by CRY:PER and clock outputs and entrainment, whereas confusables cover PPAR/ROR metabolic coupling or MECP2/NPAS4 neuronal transcription.

qualifier: proton-coupled di- and oligopeptides
name: Proton-coupled di- and oligopeptide transport
rationale: All members concern proton/oligopeptide cotransport of di- and oligopeptides, unlike confusables on amino acid transporters or NOD-mediated muramyl dipeptide sensing.

core: Spliceosomal snRNA biogenesis and pre-mRNA splicing
qualifier: snRNA gene transcription with spliceosome assembly
name: snRNA transcription and spliceosome-mediated pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members combine Pol II/Pol III snRNA gene transcription and cap hypermethylation with spliceosome assembly and major/minor splicing, unlike confusables on histone mRNA processing, generic Pol III transcription or nuclear RNA decay.

qualifier: netrin-mediated attraction and repulsion
name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and chemorepulsion
rationale: Members share netrin signaling in axon extension and chemorepulsion, including dopaminergic, serotonergic and DRG axon guidance, whereas confusables carry Sema3A-plexin signaling or collateral sprouting.

qualifier: GLUT4 translocation driven by insulin, adiponectin and muscle activity
name: GLUT4 glucose uptake regulation by insulin, adiponectin and exercise
rationale: Members share regulation of glucose import via GLUT4 translocation (RHOQ, insulin sensitization, adiponectin, muscle activity/PGC-1alpha), distinct from confusables on glucagon/gluconeogenesis, insulin secretion, fatty acid handling or adipogenesis.

qualifier: biogenesis/protein import with peroxisomal fatty acid and ether-lipid metabolism
name: Peroxisome biogenesis and peroxisomal fatty acid and ether-lipid metabolism
rationale: Members share peroxisomal protein import and fission plus very-long/branched-chain fatty acid alpha/beta-oxidation, elongation and plasmalogen synthesis, unlike confusables on cholesterol synthesis or bile acid synthesis.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes, including cardiomyocyte adhesion
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome junctions in epithelium and cardiomyocytes
rationale: Members share desmosome/hemidesmosome assembly and intermediate filament-linked cell-cell adhesion including cardiomyocyte coupling, distinct from confusables on cornification/skin barrier or adherens junctions and apical polarity.

qualifier: monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface modules
name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell transcriptional signatures
rationale: Members are blood module signatures enriched in monocytes, dendritic cells and neutrophils (surface, differentiation, myeloid receptors), unlike confusables focused on MHC antigen presentation, activated DCs or PU.1-driven monocyte activation.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and host blockade of viral invasion and release
name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated restriction of viral entry and release
rationale: Members share ISG15-mediated and IFN-alpha-induced antiviral effector activity, and uniquely include host suppression of viral invasion and release, whereas confusables carry OAS/PKR, IFN signaling regulation or generic ubiquitination.

qualifier: amyloid-beta clearance and fibril formation
name: Amyloid-beta clearance and regulation of amyloid fibril formation
rationale: All members concern clearing amyloid-beta or regulating amyloid fibril formation, while confusables centre on microglial activation and pro-amyloid regulation.

qualifier: factor VIII and IX variant defects (hemophilia A/B)
name: Factor VIII and IX defects of intrinsic coagulation
rationale: Members are defective F8 and F9 processing, secretion and activity variants within the intrinsic pathway, whereas confusables cover the broader coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis, FXII/kallikrein or VWF defects.

core: Glial and amyloid regulation in neurodegeneration
qualifier: glial activation, proliferation and survival with pro-amyloid and tangle regulation
name: Glial activation, survival and pro-amyloid, tau-tangle regulation
rationale: Members share regulation of astrocyte/microglial activation, glial proliferation and apoptosis together with promotion of amyloid-beta formation, reduced clearance and tangle assembly, unlike confusables centred on amyloid clearance, microglial immune function or APP biosynthesis.

qualifier: segment patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
name: Nephron patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
rationale: Members share nephron proximal-distal patterning and comma- and S-shaped body to tubule morphogenesis, distinct from confusables on nephric duct, metanephric mesenchyme/MET, renal vesicle or ureter development.
